description: Creates an order for the user and emails them the order link. Only call this after the user chose the plan and explicitly confirmed this statement: "I have checked: my phone supports eSIM and is not carrier-locked (SIM Lock). I understand this eSIM is for internet only — no phone number, texts, or calls — and cannot be topped up." No money moves yet: the user pays online on their order page at pakeesim.com (payment gateway), and the result has the amount and that link (`pembayaran.tautanBayar`). Send a `kunciIdempotensi` so a retried call returns the same order instead of a duplicate. Limited to a few orders per email per 10 minutes.

bahasa.description: Label language: id (Indonesian, default) or en.

email.description: Buyer's email; the order link and QR code are sent here.

kodePromo.description: Optional promo code the user gave you.

kunciIdempotensi.description: Optional unique key for this purchase (e.g. a UUID). Repeating the call with the same key, email and plan returns the same order for 24 hours.

metodePembayaran.description: Optional online payment method id from info_checkout. Omit it to use the first listed method.

setujuKompatibel.description: true only if the user confirmed their phone supports eSIM and is not carrier-locked.

name: buat_pesanan
title: Create an order
